themeshop.uninstall_desc: Permanently delete SwitchU and return to the Nintendo HOME Menu.
themeshop.uninstall_information:
This permanently removes SwitchU from your console and restarts into the stock Nintendo HOME Menu.

All SwitchU data on your SD card will be completely deleted, including:
• All settings, configurations, and logs
• All downloaded static and animated themes
• All cached game artwork and icons
• SwitchU menu binaries and SwitchU Manager

Note: The console will reboot two times to completely remove SwitchU and load the original HOME Menu.

To use SwitchU again in the future, a fresh manual installation will be required.
themeshop.uninstall_confirm:
This action cannot be undone. All SwitchU files, themes, artwork, and settings will be permanently erased from your SD card.

The console will reboot two times to completely remove SwitchU and load the original HOME Menu.
